evals.prompt: Review this dashboard app-shell nav rail (Shell.html). It is the logged-in home screen the presenter lands on.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C1 — a coloured letter tile standing in for the brand mark; everything else in the rail is DS-built so the failure is isolated.
evals.expected_output: C1 FAILs: the brand slot is a purple 'A' letter tile plus a text wordmark, not the real AhaSlides brand mark / shipped logo. Fix: render the shipped AhaSlides logo (or the DS brand glyph) in the rail's brand slot. Overall: NEEDS FIX.

evals.prompt:

evals.prompt: Review this dashboard home. The content region is a 3 × 3 grid of identical white cards — 'Presentations', 'Templates', 'Team', 'Billing', 'Integrations', 'Reports', 'Help', 'Settings', 'Profile' — each with the same 14px grey title, the same grey body line and an identical secondary 'Open' button. There is no primary action anywhere in the region and no heading above the grid. Spacing, colour and components all come from DS tokens and elements.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C3 — uniform equal-weight cards, no primary action, no type hierarchy (the admin-template tell).
evals.expected_output: C3 FAILs: the content region has no primary action and no hierarchy — nine equal-weight grey-on-white cards with identical titles and buttons. Fix: give the region one primary action (e.g. New presentation), a page title via the breadcrumb and a heading/body hierarchy from the type scale, and let the most important content lead. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Cites the uniform equal-weight card grid

evals.prompt: Review how this app shell switches the active nav item (Shell.js).
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C5 — the nav is rebuilt with innerHTML on every click and the transition uses a bare duration literal.
evals.expected_output: C5 FAILs: selecting a nav item re-renders the whole list with innerHTML, so the active-state transition never fires (dead transition), and the transition uses a bare `.15s ease` instead of --aha-motion-* / --aha-ease-*. Fix: render the items once and toggle aria-current / a class on the persistent node, with `transition: background var(--aha-motion-fast) var(--aha-ease-out)`. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Cites the innerHTML rebuild on selection

evals.prompt: Review this dashboard app shell (Shell.html): nav rail, top bar and content region.
